defaults.permitted_development: Across Tyne and Wear, detached domestic garages are usually easiest on the planning permission route when they stay clearly secondary to the house, respect height and boundary relationships, and avoid creating a more dominant frontage or access arrangement. The planning route is usually strongest when the garage looks like a subordinate domestic building rather than a second focal point on the plot.

rules.height_rules: Garage proposals across Tyne and Wear are normally judged first on overall height, eaves height and whether the roof form keeps the building subordinate to the main house.
rules.depth_rules: The main footprint issue for garages across Tyne and Wear is whether the building still reads as a modest supporting outbuilding. A garage that spreads too far into the plot, frontage or remaining garden usually needs a closer planning check.
rules.boundary_rules: Boundary siting, neighbour relationship and vehicle access are the recurring pressure points for garages in Tyne and Wear, especially where a new crossover or tight turning arrangement is involved.
rules.roof_rules: Low-profile garage roofs are generally easier than taller roof forms that create storage volume, apparent accommodation or a more dominant outbuilding shape.
rules.materials_rules: Garages are normally easiest to support when the materials, door treatment and overall appearance sit comfortably with the house and local street scene.

rules.permitted_development: In Gateshead, a detached garage is usually easiest to keep off the formal planning permission route when it remains clearly secondary to the house, sits comfortably within the plot and does not create a more dominant frontage or access arrangement. rules.materials_rules: Materials and frontage treatment should help the garage read as a subordinate domestic building in Gateshead, not as a visually dominant addition to the property.

restrictions.conservation_area: Garages in conservation areas within Gateshead often receive a closer design review where they affect the character of a visible frontage or the wider street scene.
restrictions.listed_building: Garages affecting a listed building or its setting in Gateshead usually need a more careful planning and heritage consent check.
